description: NaTc₁₂Br₂₅ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are a spread of Na-Br bond distances ranging from 3.03-3.33 Å. There are six inequivalent Tc sites. In the first Tc site, Tc is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four Br atoms. There are a spread of Tc-Br bond distances ranging from 2.49-3.23 Å. In the second Tc site, Tc is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Br atoms. There are a spread of Tc-Br bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.52 Å. In the third Tc site, Tc is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four Br atoms. There are a spread of Tc-Br bond distances ranging from 2.47-3.29 Å. In the fourth Tc site, Tc is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four Br atoms. There are a spread of Tc-Br bond distances ranging from 2.48-3.07 Å. In the fifth Tc site, Tc is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Br atoms. There are two shorter (2.47 Å) and one longer (2.48 Å) Tc-Br bond length. In the sixth Tc site, Tc is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Br atoms. There are a spread of Tc-Br bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.53 Å. There are thirteen inequivalent Br sites. In the first Br site, Br is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Tc atoms. In the second Br site, Br is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Tc atoms. In the third Br site, Br is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Tc atoms. In the fourth Br site, Br is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Tc atoms. In the fifth Br site, Br is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Tc atoms. In the sixth Br site, Br is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Tc atom. In the seventh Br site, Br is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Tc atom. In the eighth Br site, Br is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Tc atoms. In the ninth Br site, Br is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Tc atoms. In the tenth Br site, Br is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Tc atom. In the eleventh Br site, Br is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Tc atom. In the twelfth Br site, Br is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Tc atom. In the thirteenth Br site, Br is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Tc atom.
